analysis.title: Swiss Number Cruncher Novartis: 3Q26 growth momentum remains intact, margins are strong, but long-term uncertainties remain
key_insights: Novartis 3Q26 turnover was USD 14,522mn, up 4.0% in local currency and 4.4% in USD, 0.5% above consensus (USD 14,452mn). FX effect 0%, price effect -1%, generic erosion -9%, volume +14%.
Core EBIT was USD 6,036mn (reported), up 10.5% YoY in USD and 8.1% above consensus of USD 5,582mn. Core EBIT margin was 41.6% vs ZKB estimate 38.5% and consensus 38.6%, about 2 pp above consensus.
Core EPS was USD 2.46 (reported), up 9.0% YoY in USD and 7.4% above consensus of USD 2.29. Core net profit was USD 4,655mn, 8.0% above consensus.
Novartis raised FY26 guidance. Revenue guidance is unchanged at low single-digit growth. Core EBIT guidance moved from a single-digit decline to flat to low single-digit growth.
Revenue growth was driven by Cosentyx (helped by a favourable YoY comparison of one-off effects), Leqvio (China NRDL inclusion) and Zolgensma (intrathecal administration, Itvisma launch).
Pluvicto (8% below consensus), Kisqali (1% below) and Scemblix (2% below) were on the weaker side. Fabhalta was 7% below consensus.
The margin beat came mainly from top-line growth and management of COGS and SG&A.
Patent expiries for Cosentyx (2029), Kisqali (2031) and Kesimpta (2031) account for almost 40% of FY29 revenue and are expected to weigh on the share price for some time.

September clinical setbacks add to the overhang: Pelacarsen in LPa, Del-desiran in DM-1, a temporary halt to cell therapies, Lu-NeoB in cancer, VBH8937 in ALS, and Novo's negative IL-6 data as a negative read-through for Pacibekitug.

Next milestone is the Meet-the-Management event on 18-19 November, where Novartis is expected to extend medium-term revenue growth targets by one year to FY31 (previously 5-6% CAGR in local currency for FY25-30). ZKB expects the core EBIT margin to be confirmed as rising back above 40% by FY29 at the latest.

Ianalumab could still be approved by year-end. FY27 is light on clinical milestones, the main ones being Phase 3 data for Leqvio and for Abelacimab (Factor XI) in stroke prevention in atrial fibrillation.
ZKB rates Novartis Market Perform (relative to the SPI, +/-5% expected relative total return) with the price at CHF 127.48. ZKB EPS estimates in USD: 2026E 7.05, 2027E 8.43 (2025: 7.21).

market_movers.rationale: Strong 3Q26 margin and a guidance raise are offset by patent expiries on Cosentyx, Kisqali and Kesimpta and September clinical setbacks. Price was CHF 127.48.

sector_views.rationale: Novartis shows solid growth and margins, but patent cliffs from 2029 and pipeline setbacks keep the long-term outlook uncertain.

earnings_insights: Novartis 3Q26 (reported 10/27/2026): turnover USD 14,522mn vs consensus USD 14,452mn and ZKB estimate USD 14,601mn, so a 0.5% beat vs consensus and a small miss vs ZKB.
Novartis 3Q26 core EBIT (reported) USD 6,036mn vs consensus USD 5,582mn and ZKB estimate USD 5,617mn. Core EBIT margin 41.6% vs consensus 38.6%.
Novartis 3Q26 core EPS (reported, core basis) USD 2.46 vs consensus USD 2.29 and ZKB estimate USD 2.29. 3Q25 was USD 2.25.
Novartis 3Q26 core net profit (reported) USD 4,655mn vs consensus USD 4,309mn and 3Q25 USD 4,329mn.
FY26 guidance raised: core EBIT now flat to low single-digit growth (previously single-digit decline). Revenue guidance unchanged at low single-digit growth.

3Q26 product sales vs consensus (reported): Cosentyx USD 1,857mn (+4%), Kisqali USD 1,821mn (-1%), Pluvicto USD 674mn (-8%), Scemblix USD 593mn (-2%), Kesimpta USD 1,484mn (-0.3%), Leqvio USD 506mn (+4%), Zolgensma USD 404mn (+12%), Fabhalta USD 237mn (-7%), Rhapsido USD 101mn (+16%).
ZKB estimates (USD): EPS 2026E 7.05 and 2027E 8.43; P/E 21.9x for 2026E and 18.3x for 2027E; dividend CHF 3.80 for 2026E and CHF 3.90 for 2027E.
risk_factors: Patent expiries for Cosentyx (2029), Kisqali (2031) and Kesimpta (2031), together almost 40% of FY29 revenue.
Clinical setbacks in September: Pelacarsen (LPa), Del-desiran (DM-1), temporary halt to cell therapies, Lu-NeoB (cancer), VBH8937 (ALS).
Novo's negative IL-6 data is a negative read-through for Pacibekitug.
Weaker-than-expected sales of Pluvicto, Kisqali and Scemblix in 3Q26.

tension_points.bull_case: 3Q26 revenue and core EBIT beat consensus, core EBIT margin was 41.6% (about 2 pp above consensus), and FY26 core EBIT guidance was raised. ZKB expects the margin to return above 40% by FY29 at the latest.
tension_points.bear_case: Patent expiries for Cosentyx (2029), Kisqali (2031) and Kesimpta (2031) cover almost 40% of FY29 revenue, and September clinical setbacks add pressure on the shares.
tension_points.what_invalidates: The 18-19 November Meet-the-Management event, where the medium-term revenue growth targets are to be extended to FY31 and the margin path confirmed.

theme_stances.key_argument: Patent expiries for Cosentyx, Kisqali and Kesimpta will keep weighing on the share price despite strong 3Q26 results.
